newsitem.title: CANADA: Avenor to focus on Repap merger.
newsitem.headline: Avenor to focus on Repap merger.

text.p: Avenor Inc said on Monday it's board of directors concluded it is inappropriate to pursue a merger offer with Domtar Inc at this time and management will instead continue to focus on a merger with Repap Enterprises Inc.

Avenor said a senior executive of Domtar last week approached Avenor and indicated that Domtar wanted to pursue negotiations with Avenor "with a view to enter into a pre-merger agreement within 72 hours."

Avenor said in a statement that it believes that a merger with Repap is in the best interests of its shareholders. If completed, this merger will well position Avenor to consider a range of significant strategic transactions in its two primary businesses, newsprint and coated and white papers.
"It is Avenor's intention to examine such alternatives as soon as possible following completion of the merger with Repap with a view to enhancing shareholder value," Avenor said.
Avenor said the Domtar offer was to be based on a market to market exchange ratio, and conditional on the merger with Repap being approved by Avenor and Repap shareholders.

Avenor said Domtar's representative confirmed the initiative was supported by its two major shareholders, the Societe Generale de Financement du Quebec and the Caisse de depot et de placements du Quebec.
"This indicated that the Caisse was prepared to vote in favor of Avenor's acquisition of Repap provided that Avenor would commit to proceed with the merger as outlined by Domtar," Avenor said.
It said its directors met to consider Domtar's proposal and concluded that it would be "inappropriate and unreasonable to pursue negotitations at this time on the basis suggested."

Avenor's managment was instructed to continue to focus on the merger with Repap and to communicate those views to Domtar. Avenor said it reiterated that position when Domtar again made the same proposal on March 21.
The vote by Repap and Avenor shareholders on the Repap deal will take place, as planned, on March 26, Avenor said.
